title: memory-assertion/v1 NL2KE Exchange Contract
description: Closed Draft-07 shapes for NL2KE request, response, error, capabilities, and readiness documents. Cross-reference closure, ontology typing, literal codec normalization, evidence replay, graph acyclicity, and snapshot hash verification require the versioned semantic validator.

binding_sha256.description: Caller-computed SHA-256 of RFC 8785 JCS UTF-8 bytes for this complete CanonicalBinding after removing binding_sha256. Source strings are not Unicode-normalized.

assertion_sha256.description: Caller-computed SHA-256 of RFC 8785 JCS UTF-8 bytes for this complete CanonicalAssertion after removing assertion_sha256. Source strings are not Unicode-normalized.

credential_ref_fingerprint.description: Caller-computed HMAC-SHA-256 fingerprint of the exact credential_ref UTF-8 bytes using a caller-owned fingerprint key. The service MUST echo this value and MUST NOT replace it with a bare hash.
Exact echo of execution.credential.credential_ref_fingerprint from the paired request.

prompt_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the raw bytes of the immutable prompt-template artifact used by the compiler. Dynamic source, context, credentials, and model responses are excluded.

request_hash.description: SHA-256 of RFC 8785 JCS UTF-8 bytes for the paired nl2ke_request after removing execution.credential.credential_ref; execution.credential.credential_ref_fingerprint remains in the preimage. The request is parsed strictly with duplicate keys and non-I-JSON values rejected; source and context strings are not Unicode-normalized.
